target_customer: Fintech companies and payments-heavy businesses that need to reconcile data across banks, processors and API providers
problem: Fintech teams spend large parts of engineering and finance time building internal reconciliation and ledger infrastructure across many payment providers.
business_model: B2B SaaS and API, tiered pricing by number of financial records
product_category: Reconciliation, ledger and financial operations infrastructure

founders.name: Kyle Maloney
founders.background_notes: Met his cofounder on engineering teams at Marqeta; later moved into product at Mercury after the acquisition.

founders.name: Travis Gibson
founders.background_notes: Almost seven years at Marqeta as an early engineer on the core payments API, later led a money movement team.

exit.reason: Intuit acquired Proper's intellectual property and hired its team; price not disclosed.

competitors.name: Meld
competitors.what: API to help fintechs solve integration issues with providers

competitors.name: Novopayment
competitors.what: API to help fintechs solve integration issues with providers

technical_complexity.rationale: Ledger and reconciliation across many bank and processor formats is standard but detail-heavy engineering; the founders brought payments API experience from Marqeta.

defensibility.rationale: Deep integration into back-office data creates some stickiness, but adjacent players such as Modern Treasury already sold reconciliation and the product could be copied by well-funded payments infrastructure firms.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied it publicly; Intuit bought the IP and hired the team in March 2024 rather than the whole company.

market_need_then: Fintech founders reported infrastructure work such as reconciliation consumed most of engineering time, and the fintech boom of 2021 created many payment-heavy companies with that pain. Customers were added weekly at the time of the seed round per the founders.

branding.domain_note: Used properfinance.io rather than proper.com; the .com was not secured as far as sources show.

brand_strength.rationale: Little press on the brand itself beyond funding coverage; a generic real word name with a suffix domain, so the brand was functional rather than a growth driver.

outcome_analysis: Proper raised a $4.3M seed from Redpoint in June 2022 with former Marqeta engineers who knew the payments pain firsthand. It did not announce a later round before Intuit acquired its IP and hired the team in March 2024, which looks like a soft landing rather than a large product exit, in a crowded space with Modern Treasury and similar tools.
notes: Acquisition date taken from a dated Mar 11, 2024 headline on the YC page; the homepage banner says Proper joined Intuit. Seed amount confirmed by TechCrunch and a PR Newswire headline in search results. Modern Treasury was mentioned by TechCrunch as a payment provider, not a direct competitor, so it is not listed as one.
